full.description: This is a micrograph showing a histological section of colon tissue. The image displays a proliferation of dysplastic glandular epithelium arranged in villous-like fronds. These structures exhibit elongated, crowded, and pseudostratified nuclei characteristic of a villous adenoma of the colon.
